verdict.rationale: Neon does offer AI-generated help inside the product: the SQL Editor has AI-powered query writing/optimization/naming assistance, the CLI 'ask' command answers questions from docs, and an AI Gateway/Functions let apps build agentic features on top of data. However, this is mostly AI assisting with writing SQL/queries and platform Q&A rather than the product proactively generating insights or suggestions from the user's actual data content, and the docs explicitly note schema (not data) is shared with the AI. missing for 10: proactive data-content insights/suggestions (e.g., anomaly detection, trend summaries) generated from stored data itself, and independent/hands-on evidence of the AI SQL Editor's quality beyond first-party docs.
